text.title: Product Operations Failure Modes
text.summary: 10 antipatterns observed across deployments, including the agent gotchas of Product Ops automation. Each pairs symptom + root-cause + concrete fix.

antipattern.symptom: PM spends 40% of week maintaining the experiment platform; discovery time dies.
antipattern.root-cause: No Product Ops function; tooling defaulted to whoever set it up.
antipattern.fix: Assign Product Ops as owner of roadmap tool, experiment platform, feedback ingest, metric warehouse; PMs off the on-call.

antipattern.symptom: Three different weekly metric rollups circulate; stakeholders ask which number is real.
antipattern.root-cause: Multiple teams produced their own rollups; no canonical owner.
antipattern.fix: Designate one canonical weekly rollup; kill or merge duplicates.

antipattern.symptom: Stakeholders re-learn the update shape each week; engagement drops.
antipattern.root-cause: No fixed template; each PM ships their own.
antipattern.fix: Mandate fixed template (north-star, delta, top-3 wins, top-3 risks, asks); enforce in CI.

antipattern.symptom: Ops headcount doubles in a year; processes still manual.
antipattern.root-cause: Default response to new pain is hiring, not automating.
antipattern.fix: Require an automation attempt + result before any Ops headcount request.

antipattern.symptom: Automating an unstable process in the first 30 days of a new product or team.
antipattern.root-cause: Automating before workflows stabilize locks in the wrong shape. Wait for at least one full delivery cycle before encoding any process as an agent flow.
antipattern.fix: Apply rule enforce-maturity-progression; no agent flow before one full delivery cycle has completed.

antipattern.symptom: Agent metric definitions that re-derive "DAU" from prose instead of reading pinned SQL.
antipattern.root-cause: LLMs hallucinate metric definitions. Always pin metric SQL in metric_kpi.definition_sql; never let the agent re-derive a definition from narrative context.
antipattern.fix: Pin every metric in metric_kpi.definition_sql (templates/ops-schema.sql) and make agents read it.

antipattern.symptom: Status-update theatre: AI-generated status updates that no one reads.
antipattern.root-cause: Tie every automated post to a named consumer, or do not generate it. Signal-to-noise collapse kills trust in the entire ops function.

antipattern.symptom: Roadmap merge conflicts when nightly agent sync overwrites a concurrent PM edit.
antipattern.root-cause: Use updated_at watermarks and conflict logs, not last-write-wins. Cross-system ID collisions (same feature in Productboard, Jira, and Linear) require an explicit mapping table.
antipattern.fix: Apply rules one-canonical-store-for-agents and pr-style-writes-for-agents; add the ID mapping table to the ops store.

antipattern.symptom: Scheduled rollups using AskUserQuestion in a headless cron context.
antipattern.root-cause: Cron jobs have no human; design every automation as headless-first with Slack-based async confirmations for write actions.
antipattern.fix: Make scheduled layer-1 jobs headless; route write confirmations to Slack.

antipattern.symptom: Unbounded historical pulls without a since/limit/max_pages guard.
antipattern.root-cause: "Show me all incidents this quarter" silently fetches tens of thousands of tickets and blows the context window. Always pass explicit bounds.
antipattern.fix: Require since/limit/max_pages on every scraper call.
